theme: Last day ashore before the sail.
greeting: An open day in Dubrovnik, Dan — nothing on the calendar, but it's your last full stretch of signal before you board tomorrow. Spend it closing the loops a week at sea would leave dangling.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 hotel is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, early bag hold, and the ~5:15 AM checkout for your Sept 20 flight all have to be arranged from dry land — charter signal is poor, and the hotel's free cancellation lapses Sept 15 while you're aboard.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: You board around 5 PM Saturday and this is still open — confirm the exact meeting spot and time, and pin down the airport transfer for disembarkation on Sept 19.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik before you board
needsAttention.detail: Cash (~200 EUR), snacks, alcohol, and any gluten-free non-perishables are far easier to grab today than once underway — Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum are closest.

needsAttention.title: Close the Florida bookings
needsAttention.detail: Confirm the Sept 27-Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb actually converted from pending, book the Sept 20-22 landing-gap nights, and lock the Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV before a week at sea takes you offline.

flagged.title: New VP, Government Affairs listings
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced roles like the Macy's VP Government Affairs posting — a scan for when you're back onshore.

flagged.title: Farewell note from EqualityMaine
flagged.detail: Gia Drew wrote to supporters about moving on from the organization.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and receipts — ICGN and Responsible Investor policy digests, NYT Cooking, PayPal and bank statements, a couple of care.com applicants.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox needs a reply before you sail.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel for Sept 19 is set
resolved.detail: Remisens Hotel Epidaurus confirmed Sept 9 — sea-view family room, breakfast included, already paid.

resolved.title: Florida rental car settled
resolved.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 SUV is no longer a hedge — with the Pathfinder driven down later, the rental is now a definite booking.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples and cool evenings call for rendering duck skin slow and crisp.

acts.line: The calendar is empty end to end — a rare open morning in Dubrovnik, and the last one before the boat.
Still no meetings; the afternoon is unstructured time you control while you've got signal to spend.
Your last evening ashore — tomorrow at five you board and the week turns to open water.
